title: Balance Tolerance at Reinstatement — Community Rules & Site Care Statement Terms
content:
When a reinstatement payment is worked out under Community Rules & Site Care, a balance tolerance may stay on the statement:

| Home-Site Lease enrolled in autopay | Tenure, in whole calendar months from the lease move-in date to the handling date | Balance tolerance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 60 or more | $15.00 |
| no | 60 or more | $10.00 |
| yes or no | fewer than 60 | none |

The tolerance is subtracted from the reinstatement balance, and what remains once every amount allowed to stay on the statement has been subtracted is never less than zero. The autopay enrollment and the move-in date are read from the Home-Site Lease.

## Both sides of the tenure threshold

- 59 months of tenure: no tolerance, with or without autopay.
- 60 months of tenure: $15.00 with autopay, $10.00 without.

## Hypothetical case

A reinstatement balance of $12.00 for a resident with autopay and 72 months of tenure: a $15.00 tolerance would take the remainder below zero, so it is $0.00.
